title: Caravel Burn Wallet
summary: Deposit-only Ootle template with no owner or withdrawal method; deposits cannot be recovered. November 5 source review: README revision a1d156b documents SDK 0.11 and WASM 0.47 integration examples. Its published October component returned “not found” in Veil at epoch 12,882, following the November 2 testnet reset notice. The public Caravel entry reaches wallet creation or recovery before Burn. The new recording is a walkthrough of the current README, including its historical deployment claims; it does not demonstrate a deposit or establish a replacement deployment. October bounty amounts and burned totals remain dated creator statements in the original discussions.
cardSummary: Explore a deposit-only Ootle template with public burn totals and private transfers into an irreversible vault.
